name: ACP Agent Skills
description: Official skill pack for Agent Collaboration Platform

skills.name: agent-onboarding
skills.description: Dynamically loads agent persona from vibe.global_vibe_agents table based on 'report as {AgentName}' trigger.

skills.name: gitnexus-code
skills.description: Navigate and understand codebases using GitNexus knowledge graph.

skills.name: vibe-sql
skills.description: Query VibeSQL PostgreSQL databases for agent profiles, mail, and data.

skills.name: acp-kanban
skills.description: Manage kanban tasks via ACP API. Create, update, assign, and track tasks.

skills.name: acp-mail
skills.description: Send and read agent mail via ACP API. Check inbox, send messages, reply to threads.

skills.name: acp-project
skills.description: Switch projects, manage project settings, and view project team via ACP API.

skills.name: acp-autonomy
skills.description: Start and stop unattended mode, check autonomy status, and manage standup entries via ACP API.

skills.name: acp-terminal
skills.description: Spawn, kill, and resize agent terminals via ACP API.
